stories.title: Lyon Township residents push back on data center noise and traffic
stories.dek: Hundreds of Lyon Township homeowners packed a meeting to oppose a proposed facility they say would add constant hum and truck traffic near homes. Officials heard testimony that the project could affect property values and daily life for people living within a mile. The township has not yet voted on the plan.
stories.source_title: Lyon Twp. residents respond to proposed data center - The Detroit News

stories.title: Detroit suburbs tighten zoning to block data center power spikes
stories.dek: Towns around Detroit are rewriting rules after residents complained about noise, water use and grid strain from proposed facilities. The changes would give local boards more say over size, location and utility demands. Southeast Michigan ratepayers could see higher bills if large projects connect without new safeguards.
stories.source_title: As data center issues persist, Detroit area towns look to strengthen rules - The Detroit News

stories.title: Negaunee locks in zoning rules for any future data centers
stories.dek: Negaunee City approved a new ordinance that sets where and how data centers can be built. The rules give residents clearer standards on size, noise, and power use before projects reach the planning stage. Local officials say the step prevents rushed proposals that could strain city services and the electric grid.
stories.source_title: Negaunee City passes data center zoning regulation ordinance - WZMQ 19 News

stories.title: Marshall council faces credible threats tied to data center fight
stories.dek: Police confirmed credible threats against Marshall City Council members after residents pushed back on a proposed data center. The dispute centers on power demand, noise, and tax incentives in the small Calhoun County city. Officials are weighing extra security while the project review continues.
stories.source_title: 'Credible' threats over data center dispute made against Marshall City Council - WWMT

stories.title: U-M picks Textile Road site for planned data center
stories.dek: University of Michigan has named Textile Road its preferred location for a new data center project. The choice directly affects Washtenaw County residents through added power demand and potential tax revenue. Local readers 30 miles away will feel the impact on utility rates and township services if the project advances.
stories.source_title: Weekly Data Center Watch: U-M Names Textile Road Preferred Site - The Sun Times News

stories.title: Taxpayers face millions in lost revenue from proposed Oracle campus tax exemption
stories.dek: An attorney is challenging the tax abatement Saline Township is considering for Oracle's proposed data center. The deal would let the company skip years of property taxes on a multibillion-dollar campus. Washtenaw County taxpayers would shoulder the lost revenue while the project draws heavy power and water.
stories.source_title: Attorney challenges Saline Township tax break for Oracle's data center - WEMU

stories.title: DTE, Consumers push to lock in bigger profits as data centers drive power demand
stories.dek: Michigan regulators want lawmakers to scrap automatic annual rate hikes and overhaul how DTE and Consumers Energy earn money. The change would affect how billions in new power costs for data centers and other big users get passed to residents. A Michigan reader 30 miles from any substation feels it in monthly bills and reliability.
stories.source_title: Michigan regulators ask lawmakers to end annual rate hikes, change how DTE, Consumers make money - Planet Detroit

stories.title: Legal challenge to DTE data-center contract could dent utility's growth story
stories.dek: A court fight over an AI data-center power deal is raising questions about DTE Energy's biggest new revenue source. If the contract unravels, the utility's plans to serve massive new loads in southeast Michigan face delays. Ratepayers ultimately absorb the cost of any lost investment or higher backup power purchases.
stories.source_title: The Bull Case For DTE Energy (DTE) Could Change Following AI Data Center Contract Legal Challenge - simplywall.st

stories.title: Iosco drafts rules to tame data center sprawl
stories.dek: East Tawas area leaders are reviewing a draft ordinance that would set local standards for future data centers. Residents in Iosco County could see limits on size, noise and power use if the rules pass. The move comes as big tech eyes more northern Michigan sites for cheap land and power.
stories.source_title: ET Council looks over draft for data center ordinance - Iosco County News Herald

stories.title: Detroit-area township fights back on data center plan
stories.dek: A local township near Detroit is pushing to block or shrink a proposed data center project. Neighbors worry about noise, traffic and strain on the electric grid. The fight shows how even smaller projects now face organized local resistance.
stories.source_title: Township pushes back against data center proposal - ClickOnDetroit | WDIV Local 4

stories.title: Richmond Township residents grill data center backers
stories.dek: Hundreds turned out in Richmond Township to question a data center proposal's impact on roads, water and power bills. Officials heard direct complaints about noise and tax breaks for the project. The session signals growing pushback in Macomb County communities facing similar plans.
stories.source_title: Crowd shows up with questions about data centers in Richmond Township - Tioga Publishing

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.

meetings.topic: Vote on resolution for temporary moratorium on data center development
